displayName: Non-Browser Process Accessing Browser Credential Stores

queryCondition.queryText:
DeviceFileEvents
| where FileName in~ ("Login Data", "Local State", "logins.json", "key4.db")
| where FolderPath has_any ("Chrome\\User Data", "Edge\\User Data", "Firefox\\Profiles", "Google/Chrome", "BraveSoftware")
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("node.exe", "node", "python.exe", "python3", "powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe", "cmd.exe")
| project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, InitiatingProcessFileName, FolderPath, FileName, ReportId

alertTemplate.title: Non-Browser Process Accessing Browser Credential Stores
alertTemplate.description: Detects scripting runtimes or untrusted binaries interacting with Chromium or Firefox credential and profile database files, consistent with stealer payloads used by WaterPlum. ISM controls: ISM-0580, ISM-1405, ISM-1657. Advisories: acsc-2026-09-22-north-korean-waterplum-contagious-interview.
alertTemplate.recommendedActions: Isolate the workstation, inspect the initiating script or binary, and revoke active browser sessions and saved credentials for the affected user (ISM controls: ISM-0580, ISM-1405, ISM-1657; Advisories: acsc-2026-09-22-north-korean-waterplum-contagious-interview).
